caption:
New kid. Big dreams. Loud doubts. ⚡🏀

Kai has three weeks until basketball tryouts, and he's behind. Level Up Your Mind Game is the story of how he trains the one thing most players never do: the mind game. 🧠

A growth-mindset comic for ages 10-16. Read aloud, and free forever.
